I'm sorry, I'm sure you worked very hard on this, but I just don't see the point. CTRL+Tab/CTRL+Shift+Tab cycles between open tabs already, and as far as I can tell, all this extension does is that with a different key combination and a little popup window. When I watched the video and read the description, I thought "No, it's gotta do something else, surely..." but, no, not really. 

Meanwhile, it reads my browsing history and the content of the sites I'm on. That kinda makes sense based on what it's supposed to do, but since there's already a keyboard shortcut for that, it makes me nervous.

Honestly, I don't see the point.
reviews.dev_reply: The main point of this extension is to speed up switching between recently used tabs and make this action as simple as possible. For example, you work with 10 tabs, the current tab is 10 and the previously visited tab is 5. And you want to switch back from the current tab (10) to the previous (5). You can use the default browser shortcuts and press Ctrl + Tab 5 times to cycle from 10 to 1, to 2 and reach 5. Or you can remember the number of the previous tab and hit Cmd + 5 (Ctrl + 5 on Windows). In the first example you are making too much work for that simple action and in the second you are maintain tabs numbers in your memory and restricted in your actions by 9 tabs (Ctrl + # works only for tabs from 1 to 9). With this extension you can always hit the same shortcut (Ctrl + Y by default) and see the list of recently used tabs. In this case you don't do much work and don't remember any tab numbers. This behaviour is similar to the one of your system's app switcher (Win + Tab, Cmd + Tab).
tags: permissions concern: history and site content

reviews.text:
I think this extension is the best I've tried, however it still has several drawbacks:

- When I run Chrome PWA app (e. g. Youtube), tab switcher cycles also through these PWA app windows and there are annoying bugs with tab order.
- When some browser text box (e.g. search window or address bar) is focused, popup doesn't get displayed.
- Zoom problems when using in PDF viewer (if PDF is zoomed in, tab switcher is zoomed out and vice versa).
- Sometimes popup stays accidentally displayed and I have to press Enter to switch the tab. Mostly it is when browser is busy (webpage is heavy or still loading).
- Bugs specific to particular websites (Google Docs - when switching to some the tab, there is no focus on the document).
- Popup switcher is not native browser function, so it is slow sometimes (especially when loading a new page) and it doesn't work on special browser pages (new tab, settings etc). It is a shame Chrome doesn't support this natively.
tags: popup not shown when textbox focused
